@yianisz Among $LITE, $COHR, Innolight, etc. I've found $LITE to be the most asymmetrical setup since it's central to ironwood (with OCS), blackwell, and other hyperscaler ASICs.  

However, $AAOI is extreme alpha. Especially as a levered play on $AMZN Trainium, $MSFT Maia ASICs scale up + one of the only InP fab in US.

Although they have $4B $AMZN warrants + purchase agreements, it does seem likely that Dec's orders were Maia-based clusters. There's rumors that $AAOI seems to be developing a new optical interconnect architecture specifically for $MSFT's silicon too.

$AAOI hasn't moved at all, despite hyperscaler ASIC hype + photonic rallies, so it's a hidden gem for sure at $2B MC. However, it is highly levered to $MSFT and $AMZN (which will likely succeed + deploy their own ASICs at scale given their own cloud departments)

mentions.text:
$AAOI is up 24% and $LITE is 5% since my thesis today.

From BOM analysis, LITE ($27B) is levered toward TPU Ironwood due to OCS but benefits from NVDA + all ASICs.

AAOI ($2.5B), is levered toward MSFT MAIA ramp and Amazon Trainium.

InP like HBM, will be a bottleneck for 2026 as they’re the foundational materials used for lasers in these deployments. 

Similar to memory bottlenecks with Micron and SK Hynix, we’ll likely see attention drawn to InP fabs, such as $AAOI, which happens to be one of the sole ones in America (COHR,Macom)

But compared to $LITE that is up 362% YTD due to the success of Google’s TPU (from Meta and Anthropic purchase orders), $AAOI is only up 7% YTD.

We’re largely seeing this because there’s a lack of retail or media attention on the $AMZN Trainium or $MSFT Maia deployments, which are largely expected to ramp up in 2026-2027. 

However they’re all likely to succeed due to each hyperscaler wanting to lower costs of inference for their own cloud platform.

If we see other hyperscalers adopt OCS for optimized performance that the TPU achieved, expect $LITE to re-rate more than they have now given their monopoly in that specific segment.

However, if we see $MSFT Maia ramp up (given $AAOI is likely developing a new architecture for them), and $AMZN Trainium ramp up ($4B warrant + purchase orders), expect $AAOI to rerate.

Photonics and InP will be the new bottleneck like memory. 

We’ll likely see investments pour down stream to players like $COHR, Innolight, $LITE, and hidden levered plays on specific hyperscaler ASICs like $AAOI as a theme in 2026.

The market is currently rewarding the Google TPU supply chain but might be missing other hyperscaler ASIC ramps.

OpenStock 上线了中际旭创 Pre-IPO 金库。

——————————

太长不看版

1. 这是首个围绕热门 A 股上市公司赴港上市事件的私有股权 RWA 项目

2. OpenStock 做的不是“股票交易更方便”，而是 Access：让链上用户参与过去很难触达的 Pre-IPO 机会

3. 这可能是 RWA 赛道的下一个方向

——————————

中际旭创本身已经是中国内地上市公司，所在赛道是光通信网络 / AI 基础设施，也是这轮 AI capex 周期里关注度很高的方向。

这次 OpenStock 上线的不是普通“上市公司股票代币化”，而是围绕中际旭创赴港上市事件设计的 Pre-IPO 金库。

用户在链上存入稳定币，现实世界里的额度获取、资产接入和流程处理，则由受监管的合作方完成。

这里最重要的一点是：
金库代币代表的是对金库净收益的索取权，而不是直接持有中际旭创股票。

所以 OpenStock 的核心不是便利性，而是参与机会。

传统 Pre-IPO / 私有市场机会，通常更接近机构、高净值、券商关系网络。OpenStock 想做的是把这类机会通过 RWA 金库结构带到链上。

————————

这也是我觉得值得关注的地方：

RWA 第一阶段是美债；
第二阶段是上市股票 / ETF 代币化；
下一阶段可能就是 Pre-IPO、私有股权、事件驱动型资产金库。

OpenStock 背后是前 Polynomial 团队。该团队此前处理过超过 90 亿美元交易量，服务超过 10 万用户，在链上衍生品和交易基础设施上有过实际经验。

mentions.text:
SK海力士赴美上市，同样的，我们的万亿AI硬件龙头正在推进港股二次上市，而OpenStock 把这个上市事件做成了链上金库参与入口。

这可能才是 OpenStock 这次中际旭创金库最值得关注的地方。

很多人一看到 RWA，就会下意识理解成“把股票搬上链”。

但中际旭创这个案例不太一样。

它不是一个还没被市场验证的链上概念资产，而是一家已经在A股上市、并且在AI算力周期里持续兑现业绩的光模块龙头。

中际旭创的核心业务是高端光通信收发模块，简单讲，就是AI数据中心里GPU集群之间高速互联的关键环节。

AI服务器越堆越多，GPU之间的数据交换越密集，800G、1.6T光模块的需求就越强。

这也是为什么中际旭创能在2025年做到营收约382亿元、归母净利润约108亿元，2026年Q1单季营收接近195亿元，归母净利润超过57亿元。

——————

真正有意思的地方在于：
中际旭创现在正在推进港股H股上市。
这就让它从一个普通A股AI硬件龙头，变成了一个明确的资本市场事件。

如果港股上市顺利推进，它面对的就不只是A股投资者，而是全球资金、港股流动性、国际AI硬件定价体系。

而 OpenStock 切入的点，正是这个“上市事件窗口”。

OpenStock 的中际旭创金库不是让你直接持有中际旭创股票，也不是简单做一个股票代币。

它更像是把过去只属于机构、券商、私募通道里的 Pre-IPO / IPO allocation access，做成了链上金库。

用户存入稳定币，获得对应金库代币。

标的上市后，金库根据实际结果结算，Vault Token 对应的是金库净收益的索取权，而不是标的股票本身的直接所有权。

所以这个产品的关键不是“链上买A股”。

而是：
一个真实A股AI硬件龙头，  一个即将发生的港股上市事件，  一个把封闭资本市场参与机会搬到链上的金库结构。

这也是我觉得 OpenStock 值得研究的原因。
RWA 的下一阶段，可能不只是把已经上市的股票搬上链。

而是把现实世界里最稀缺的东西搬上链：
Access。

而这个Access，还是之前未有人触及的内地股票赴港上市

Goldman Sachs raised Innolight PT to 2581 RMB. Roughly 163.6% upside from current valuations.

But the largest thing is its 2026–2028 earnings est revision raised by a whopping 65%/108%/119%, based on:

-  Much higher silicon photonics module volumes
- scale out, scale up, scale across volumes
- 1.6T/3.2T lifting blended ASP + margins
- increase in AI capex

This is typically very material read through on the optical sector since:

I tend to think of Innolight as a $TSM (semi capex) type read on how the photonics landscape is doing.

Eg. Higher silicon photonics penetration means more TAM for cw lasers like $SIVE (cw) / SOI wafer demand for $SOI. ASP hikes for future gen is positive for the other optical markers too.

Think my other takeaway outside the report was Innolight stating 800g demand was growing more significantly than expected from their transcript on the 12th. 

Which in turn signals more demand for names like $AAOI to $LITE next earnings.

TLDR: GS gives high earnings projections during a time of massive corrections. 

Fundamentally, broader photonics ecosystem should be happy when it’s ER time.
